s.how: Simmer 500g Seville oranges whole in 1.2L water for 1 hour, halve, scoop out the pips and shred the peel. Return to the liquid with 1kg sugar and the juice of 1 lemon and boil hard to 105C, then jar and cool. Butter 8 slices white bread thickly, spread with marmalade and cut into triangles.

s.note: Paddington's disastrous day at the barber shop
s.how: Rub 60g cold butter into 350g self-raising flour, mix in 250ml milk lightly, pat out and cut into fingers. Glaze with milk and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Serve with strawberry jam and clotted cream.

m.n: Prison canteen chicken and leek pie
m.note: the grim canteen he turns into something lovely
m.how: Cook 800g diced chicken thighs in 40g butter until browned, then add 2 sliced leeks and 250g sliced mushrooms and soften. Stir in 2 tbsp flour, then 250ml chicken stock, 200ml cream, 1 tsp Dijon and thyme and simmer until thick. Cool, tip into a pie dish, top with puff pastry and brush with egg. Bake at 200C for 30 minutes. Serve with 300g buttered peas.

w.note: the prison uniforms that come out of the wash pink
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour. Bake in two tins at 180C for 22 minutes. Fill with raspberry jam and 200ml whipped cream. Top with pale pink icing.

d.note: tea for the whole cell block
d.how: Brew 5 tea bags in 1.2L boiling water for 4 minutes and remove. Stir in 4 tbsp orange marmalade and the juice of a lemon until dissolved, then chill. Fill four tall glasses with ice and orange slices, pour in the tea and top each with a splash of soda water.
